description: Defines classes and interfaces for HIDL sensor hardware abstraction layer wrapper, including error logging, death handling, and sensor communication mechanisms.

classes.name: HidlTransportErrorLog
classes.description: Represents a log entry for HIDL transport errors with timestamp and count.

classes.name: SensorsHalDeathReceiver
classes.description: Handles death notifications for the HIDL sensor HAL service.

classes.name: HidlSensorHalWrapper
classes.description: Implements the ISensorHalWrapper interface, managing sensor communication, connection, and error handling.

methods.name: serviceDied
methods.description: Callback invoked when the sensor HAL service dies.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the sensor HAL service.

methods.name: prepareForReconnect
methods.description: Prepares the wrapper for reconnecting to the sensor service.

methods.name: supportsMessageQueues
methods.description: Checks if message queues are supported.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Configures batching parameters for a sensor.
